outcome: Prevalence of labor and delivery medicalization
cohort: 358 postpartum women attending the Brazilian Public Health System
finding: The prevalence of labor and delivery medicalization was high (92.7%), and was associated with being primigravida and having a history of cesarean section.
mod_finding: The study found a link between medical interventions, particularly highlighting the association of trichotomy with cesarean section and induction/augmentation with amniotomy and episiotomy.
